title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 7: Even in the Innocent

scenes.say: Forward operating base. Night. Ali on watch. Desert wind howls.
scenes.visual: a soldier on watch at a desert base gate at night, wind blowing sand, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: A local boy, ten years old, walks toward the gate holding something.
scenes.visual: a small boy walking toward a guarded gate at night, holding a round object, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali, that kid's not allowed in the zone!
scenes.visual: a guard tower spotlight cutting through the dark, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali aims. The boy drops the object.
scenes.visual: a rifle raised at night, silhouette, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
a soccer ball rolling in the sand under a spotlight, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
a soldier lowering his rifle, head bowed, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: We were trained to see threats, even in the innocent.
scenes.visual: the empty gate at night with a soccer ball in the sand, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Later, in a makeshift chapel, he lights a candle. He doesn't pray. Just stares.
scenes.visual: a single candle in a makeshift tent chapel, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: The chaplain: You don't gotta believe in God. Just believe you ain't alone. That's harder.
scenes.visual: a chaplain sitting beside a soldier on a bench, candlelight, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: I wasn't religious. But I was desperate.
scenes.visual: a candle flame flickering in the dark, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Eight. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a cross made of sticks on a sandbag wall at dawn, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 7 of 25: Even in the Innocent. From the screenplay by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
